This server-authored capability index contains names only. Advertised definitions are not execution authority; advertised_state describes current eligibility. Active authorized tools are provided automatically. Use describe_tools with exact names only when you need missing parameter details or a budget-hidden tool. Application-scope approval does not require loading individual action schemas first. Loading grants no authority and cannot change readiness.
